open_points.subject: change_service_principal_status
open_points.text: change_service_principal_status: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_service_principal of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository, and through its list_service_credentials, its update_service_credential and its update_service_principal.
open_points.other_text: change_service_principal_status: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append, with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, a single audit built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, passing as action the transition it performed — the PRINCIPAL_DISABLE member of = models.AuditAction or its PRINCIPAL_ENABLE member — the SERVICE_PRINCIPAL member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the principal identifier as entity_id and None as project_id. A request for the status the principal already holds changes nothing and appends no audit.
open_points.question: Must the dependency note be limited to service-identity persistence reads and writes, or must append_audit be included among the permitted writes?

open_points.subject: create_service_principal
open_points.text: create_service_principal: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through insert_service_principal of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository.
open_points.other_text: create_service_principal: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the PRINCIPAL_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction as action, the SERVICE_PRINCIPAL member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the service_principal_id of the new principal as entity_id and None as project_id.
open_points.question: Must the dependency note be limited to service-identity persistence, or must it also permit the required audit write through append_audit?

open_points.subject: grant_producer_project
open_points.text: grant_producer_project: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_producer_grant of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository, and through its get_service_principal and its insert_producer_grant.
open_points.other_text: grant_producer_project: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST authorize access management with the imported authorize_access_management, validate the same active Registry UUID with validate_project_reference before the transaction, reject an existing active pair, and append the PRODUCER_GRANT_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction atomically.
open_points.question: Must “each read and write” be restricted to service-identity persistence, or must the dependency note permit the required Registry read through validate_project_reference and audit append?

open_points.subject: grant_producer_project
open_points.text: grant_producer_project: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_producer_grant of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository, and through its get_service_principal and its insert_producer_grant.
open_points.other_text: grant_producer_project: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the PRODUCER_GRANT_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction as action, the PRODUCER_GRANT member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the grant_id of the new grant as entity_id and the validated project_id as project_id.
open_points.question: Must the dependency note be limited to service-identity repository operations, or must append_audit be included among the permitted writes?

open_points.subject: issue_service_credential
open_points.text: issue_service_credential: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_service_principal and insert_service_credential of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository.
open_points.other_text: issue_service_credential: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST allocate the next key_version, insert the built credential and append the PRINCIPAL_CREDENTIAL_ISSUE member of = models.AuditAction atomically, and expose the plaintext exactly once, only in the returned ServiceCredentialIssue.
open_points.question: Must the dependency note permit the audit write required by the security note, or must the security note stop requiring that append?

open_points.subject: issue_service_credential
open_points.text: issue_service_credential: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_service_principal and insert_service_credential of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository.
open_points.other_text: _next_key_version: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through list_service_credentials of the repository it is given.
open_points.question: Must issue_service_credential's permitted reads include the list_service_credentials read performed to allocate its required next key version, or must key-version allocation be changed?

open_points.subject: issue_service_credential
open_points.text: issue_service_credential: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_service_principal and insert_service_credential of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository.
open_points.other_text: issue_service_credential: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_service_credential_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the PRINCIPAL_CREDENTIAL_ISSUE member of = models.AuditAction as action and the new credential.
open_points.question: Must the dependency note be limited to service-identity persistence, or must append_audit be included among the permitted writes?

open_points.subject: revoke_producer_project
open_points.text: revoke_producer_project: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_producer_grant_by_id and update_producer_grant of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository.
open_points.other_text: revoke_producer_project: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the PRODUCER_GRANT_REVOKE member of = models.AuditAction as action, the PRODUCER_GRANT member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the revoked grant_id as entity_id and the project_id of the revoked grant as project_id.
open_points.question: Must the dependency note be limited to producer-grant persistence, or must append_audit be included among the permitted writes?

open_points.subject: revoke_service_credential
open_points.text: revoke_service_credential: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_service_credential and update_service_credential of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository.
open_points.other_text: revoke_service_credential: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_service_credential_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the PRINCIPAL_CREDENTIAL_REVOKE member of = models.AuditAction as action and the revoked credential.
open_points.question: Must the dependency note be limited to credential persistence, or must append_audit be included among the permitted writes?
